title: Dr. And Mrs. Harry Goodman - Dr. Hechtman

page_data.en:
SECRET
Private and Confidential

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL / REGISTRY / N. N. SHANGHAI... / 9th June, 1941. 41）

Dear Mr. Sharman,

I have received information that Canadian passport No.45928 issued to a Dr. and Mrs. Harry Goodman, by the Canadian Legation at Tokyo in 1937, is now in the possession of Dr. Hechtman, Dentist, at 112 Majestic Apartments, 788 Bubbling Well Road, Shanghai. I am informed that Dr. Hechtman is stated to be a Roumanian Jew and the proprietor of the "Argentine Ballroom". So far as I am aware Dr. Harry Goodman died two years ago.

When Dr. and Mrs. Harry Goodman applied, through the then Canadian Government Trade Commissioner, Mr. Scott, for their new passport, they were stated to to living at Nanchang, China. Their new passports were handed by Mr. Scott to Mr. Harry M. Stuckgold of Lane 409, House A-35, Szechuen Road, Shanghai, who undertook to deliver the passport to them.

I do not know whether it will be possible for you to ascertain whether Dr. Hechtman is in possession of this passport and if so whether you are able, on the grounds that it is the property of His Majesty's Government in Canada, to recover the passport in question. At any rate I should be grateful for anything you can do and if it is necessary for you to have any official request to take action I will arrange for this to be made.

Once again may I thank you for your extremely valuable co-operation in these matters.

Yours sincerely,

V. Sharman, Esquire,
Assistant Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

机密
私人且保密

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 英国驻上海总领事馆 / 登记处 / N. N. 上海... / 1941年6月9日. 41）

亲爱的沙曼先生：

我获悉，由加拿大驻东京公使馆于1937年签发给哈里·古德曼博士及其夫人的加拿大护照（第45928号），现由上海静安寺路788号美琪公寓112室的牙医赫克特曼博士持有。据称，赫克特曼博士是一名罗马尼亚犹太人，也是“阿根廷舞厅”的业主。据我所知，哈里·古德曼博士已于两年前去世。

当哈里·古德曼博士及其夫人通过当时的加拿大政府贸易专员斯科特先生申请新护照时，据说他们居住在中国南昌。他们的新护照由斯科特先生交给上海四川路409弄A-35号的哈里·M·斯塔克戈尔德先生，由其负责将护照转交给他俩。

我不知道您是否能查明赫克特曼博士是否持有该护照，如果是的话，您能否以该护照属加拿大英王陛下政府财产为由，追回该护照。无论如何，我将感激您所能提供的任何帮助；如果您需要正式的请求以便采取行动，我将安排发出此类请求。

再次感谢您在这些事项中极为宝贵的合作。

此致

敬礼

V. 沙曼 先生
助理总监
上海公共租界工部局警务处
上海

SECRET
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / SP. BN. REGISTRY / No. N. 917）
June 12, 1941.

Dr. and Mrs. Harry Goodman : Inquiry from H.B.M. Passport Office

In connection with an enquiry from H.B.M. Passport
Office, a member of Special Branch Foreign Staff visited
the Passport Office and was shown two photographs attached
to an application for a passport in the name of Dr. and Mrs.
Harry Goodman. There was no difficulty in identifying the
originals of the photographs as Dr. and Mrs. L. Hechtman
of 882 Bubbling Well Road.

Such evidence of identity was considered sufficient
by the Passport Office which stated it did not wish for
further enquiries but would appreciate a copy of this report.

（批：Leake / D8039F/141030）

机密
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 特别班登记处 / 编号 N. 917）
1941年6月12日。

哈里·古德曼博士及夫人：来自英王陛下护照处的查询

就英王陛下护照处的一项查询而言，特别班外籍职员中的一名成员访问了护照处，并被出示了附在一份以哈里·古德曼博士及夫人名义申请的护照上的两张照片。毫无困难地将照片原件确认为静安寺路882号的L. 赫克特曼博士及其夫人。

护照处认为这种身份证明证据已足够充分，并表示不希望进行进一步查询，但希望能获得本报告副本一份。

（批注：Leake / D8039F/141030）

归档

7 6 21
